slate-1.displayName: Warm Slate 1 — NOT a page surface: avatar ring and update-prompt gradient end only

chalk-dim.displayName: Chalk Dim — all secondary and tertiary text (60% chalk; 5.29:1 on a bottom sheet, the tightest real ground)

chalk-faint.displayName: Chalk Faint — decoration only, never text (26% chalk; ~2.1:1)

line.displayName: Hairline — every solid border in the system (18% chalk)

ink-on-coral.displayName: Accent Ink on Coral — button label

ink-on-accent.displayName: Accent Ink — text sitting on any pigment fill

display.purpose: The wordmark only: splash screen and login crest. Appears twice in the entire product.

headline.purpose: Top-bar page titles, bottom-sheet titles, empty-state headings (30–34px).

title.purpose: Names of things: group names, Lunch / Dinner block headings, 'Week 24', 'Notes' (23–28px).

body.purpose: Everything a user reads to act. Inputs held at 16px so iOS does not zoom on focus.

label.purpose: Field and section labels, nav tabs, meal-tile captions, badges. Always uppercase, 0.12–0.24em tracking.

mono.purpose: Only where a value is a value: version strings, build hashes on the About page.

shadows.name: floating-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Toast and update prompt exclusively — the two things that float free of the board. Never on a card, row, button, tile, or bar.

motion.name: press-strong
motion.purpose: Active-state feedback on large tap targets (meal tiles).

motion.name: press-soft
motion.purpose: Active-state feedback on buttons and icon buttons.

motion.name: sheet-rise
motion.purpose: Bottom sheets entering. The scrim fades over the same 0.16s.

motion.name: prompt-rise
motion.purpose: The PWA update prompt only — slower because it is unsolicited and must not startle.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The splash-screen crest ring. The only looping animation in the product.

motion.name: dot-bounce
motion.value: bounce with 0.16s stagger across three dots
motion.purpose: The spinner. There is no ring spinner and no skeleton screen in this system.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.value: 448px (max-w-md) — the app column never grows past a phone width

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only solid-colour control in the system. Coral means 'press this'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 15px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-coral, #e9806a); color: var(--color-ink-on-coral, #221311); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: a hairline outline and dim label that rises to full chalk on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 15px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 40px hairline circle holding a chalk-filtered stroked glyph. Every bar action in the product is one of these.

components.css: .ds-icon-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); border-color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-icon-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.25; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Uppercase letter-spaced label over a transparent input on a chalk underline that turns coral on focus. Never a box.
components.html: Everyone in the group sees this name.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); } .ds-field-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-field-line:focus-within { border-bottom-color: var(--color-coral, #e9806a); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 2px; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); } .ds-field-help { margin-top: 6px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); }

components.name: Meal Tile
components.description: The product's core control: one tap flips lunch or dinner. Sage check = in, red cross = out. There is no unset state and no save.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: clamp(64px, 20vw, 74px); height: 54px; border-radius: 14px; border-width: 1.5px; border-style: solid; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.12s; } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(0.93); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-mark { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; } .ds-tile-cap { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-tile-on { border-color: var(--color-sage, #9cc08a); background: rgba(156,192,138,0.15); color: var(--color-sage, #9cc08a); } .ds-tile-off { border-color: var(--color-red, #df6253); background: rgba(223,98,83,0.15); color: var(--color-red, #df6253); }

components.name: Member Badge
components.description: Who is eating, as a wrapping row of avatar chips. The avatar fill is a deterministic hash of the member's name.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(241,234,217,0.05); color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; } .ds-badge-av { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-coral, #e9806a); color: var(--color-ink-on-accent, #1b1f1c); font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; } .ds-badge-av-2 { background: var(--color-sage, #9cc08a); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent chalk over slate with a hairline. The dashed variant frames something provisional or empty.
components.html:
Sunday
Four in for lunch, two for dinner.
No invite links yet.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px 18px; margin-bottom: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(241,234,217,0.05); color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); } .ds-card-dashed { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--color-chalk-faint, rgba(241,234,217,0.26))); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); }

components.name: Bottom Nav

components.name: Week Navigator
components.description: Fixed-width week box flanked by circular controls that flex cannot shrink. The mustard 'Now' chip pins right on the current week and is removed otherwise.
components.html:
Week 24
2026
Now

components.name: Toast
components.description: The only element besides the update prompt allowed to cast a shadow — it floats free of the board. Auto-dismisses at 2.4s.
components.html: Group renamed

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: The base shell every modal in the product is built from: slate-2 panel, 22px top corners, dashed grab handle, black/55 scrim. Rises 16px over 0.16s; closes on Escape and on scrim tap; locks body scroll while open.
components.html:
New group

Every sheet in the product is this shell with different contents. Nothing else in the system may slide in from an edge.

components.name: Confirm Sheet
components.description: Generic destructive confirm — kick, revoke, leave. A red icon plaque states the stakes before the words do; the destructive action is a danger button over a ghost Cancel.
components.html:
Remove Claire?

She loses access to this group and her schedule for it. She can be invited back at any time.

components.description: The type-to-confirm variant, reserved for the one irreversible action in the product. The title is red rather than chalk, and the destructive button stays locked at 40% opacity until the typed text matches the group name exactly.
components.html:
Delete Maison Dubois

Permanently deletes the group and all schedules, notes & invites for 4 members. This cannot be undone.

components.css: .ds-sheet-panel { padding: 12px 20px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, rgba(241,234,217,0.18)); border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; background: var(--color-slate-2, #262c28); color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); } .ds-sheet-handle { width: 40px; margin: 0 auto 12px; border-bottom: 2px dashed var(--color-chalk-faint, rgba(241,234,217,0.26))); } .ds-note-head { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-sheet-title { font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; } .ds-note-date { margin-top: 4px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); } .ds-note-block { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-note-meal { margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Caveat, cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; } .ds-note-lunch { color: var(--color-mustard, #e7c24d); } .ds-note-dinner { color: var(--color-coral, #e9806a); } .ds-note-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-chalk-faint, rgba(241,234,217,0.26))); background: transparent; outline: none; resize: none; color: var(--color-chalk, #f1ead9); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-note-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--color-coral, #e9806a); border-bottom-style: solid; } .ds-note-input::placeholder { font-style: italic; color: var(--color-chalk-dim, rgba(241,234,217,0.6)); }

narrative.overview:
This is the board by the fridge. Not a café's specials board performing for the street — the household's own slate, where somebody writes who's home for dinner, and everybody else reads it on the way past. It is domestic and unpolished by intent: the lettering is hand-drawn, the rules are dashed, the surface has chalk dust in it. Nobody is being sold anything on this board.

Everything follows from the material. The ground is warm dark slate (#0d100e under a radial lift toward #16201a), never neutral grey and never black; surfaces are made by laying translucent chalk over that slate at 4–6% rather than by stacking lit cards. Structure is drawn, not built: a hairline at 18% chalk divides, a dashed hairline at 26% groups or marks something provisional. Type does the emotional work — Caveat carries every name in the product, Archivo carries every instruction — and colour is rationed hard: one warm accent for action, one for secondary marks, and a green/red pair that means one thing only.

The density is generous rather than tight. This is a phone app used one-handed in a hallway for about eight seconds, so tap targets are large (54–74px meal tiles, 40px icon buttons), text is never smaller than 9px and anything that small is uppercase and letter-spaced to stay readable. The redesign this system replaced was generic soft-Material: floating drop-shadow cards, gradient app bars, blurred gradient blobs. Those are the confirmed anti-references, and their absence is the point.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark slate ground with baked-in chalk-dust grain; dark-only, permanently
Hand-lettered Caveat for names, letter-spaced uppercase Archivo for instructions
Depth by translucency and hairline, not by shadow
Sage/red meal state that is never grey and never empty
Stroked SVG icons roughened by a displacement filter so every line looks drawn
One-tap, no-save, no-dialog interaction — motion exists only to confirm a press

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only colour that means "press this". Mustard marks and labels but never becomes a button; a screen with two competing accent buttons is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Colour Verdict Rule
rules.body: Sage and red carry exactly two meanings between them — in / out for a meal, and succeeded / failed for system feedback. They are never decoration, never a category colour, never a chart colour.

rules.name: The Never-Grey Rule
rules.body: No state is communicated by greying something out, with one exception: days already past are dimmed to 45% because they are no longer editable. Everything else that is "off" is red and explicit. An unset meal and a refused meal must not look alike.

rules.name: The Chalk-Hand Rule
rules.body: Caveat is for the names of things — the app, a group, a day-part, a week — and for the occasional handwritten aside ("nobody yet — quiet one"). It never sets body copy, button labels, form labels, or anything a user must read precisely under time pressure.

rules.name: The Small-Caps Rule
rules.body: Any text below ~12px is uppercase Archivo with at least 0.12em tracking. Small lowercase body text does not exist in this system; if a label is too small to letter-space, it is too small to ship.

rules.name: The Whole-Week Rule
rules.body: The week is never paginated into a day view for editing. Seven day rows, two tap targets each, all on one screen. Any design that makes a user drill into a day to declare a meal is wrong regardless of how it looks.

rules.name: The Reserved-Slot Rule
rules.body: Controls that appear conditionally are hidden, not removed — the jump-to-today button keeps its slot with `invisible`, and the week box is a fixed 200px so it does not resize when the "Now" chip appears. Layout must not shift as state changes.

rules.name: The Flat-Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces that live on the board are shadowless, always. A shadow is permission to float, and only three things may float: the toast, the update prompt, and a bottom sheet over its scrim.

rules.name: The Dashed-Line Rule
rules.body: Solid hairline = structural division. Dashed hairline = provisional, optional, empty, or hand-drawn. Never use dashed to divide two equally solid things.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Rendered Rule
rules.body: Every glyph in the product goes through the chalk filter. No imported icon set, no icon font, no emoji, no filled/solid icon styles.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Text Rule
rules.body: Text and meaningful icons get exactly two tiers: chalk and chalk-dim. There is no third, fainter legible tier worth having: clearing 4.5:1 on the sheet ground takes roughly 52% or more, which sits close enough to chalk-dim to be indistinguishable and nowhere near chalk-faint. When a label feels too loud at 60%, make it smaller or shorter; never dimmer. chalk-faint (~2.1:1) is decoration — it is the token that was genuinely failing, and it used to carry section labels, nav labels and placeholders.

rules.name: The Bar-Is-Not-Lighter Rule
rules.body: The sticky top bar fades from slate-0, chosen to sit within a shade of the page ground's top value. A bar lighter than the board it sits on reads as a floating panel, which this system does not have.

dos: Do build depth from translucent chalk (rgba(241,234,217,0.04–0.06)) plus a hairline (18% chalk), not from shadow. Reserve 0 18px 44px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) for the toast and the update prompt.
Do set every name in Caveat and every instruction in Archivo — the Chalk-Hand Rule.
Do letter-space and uppercase anything under 12px (0.12–0.24em).
Do make "not eating" red and explicit. The Never-Grey Rule: only the past may be dimmed.
Do keep coral as the only pressable colour and mustard as a marking colour.
Do give every tappable element active:scale-[0.93–0.98] — it is the only motion budget the system has.
Do pad for the notch: pt-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] on bars, env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on the nav and every sheet.
Do draw new icons as stroked SVG through the shared #chalk displacement filter, and reduce the displacement scale at small sizes so they stay legible.
Do hold input text at 16px so iOS does not zoom on focus.
Do hide conditional controls (invisible) rather than removing them, and fix the width of containers whose contents change — the layout must not shift.
Do keep text and meaningful icons on chalk or chalk-dim only — the Two-Tier Text Rule. chalk-faint is for dashed rules, grab handles, indicator dots, and empty-state illustration.
Do signal focus with more than colour: the field underline turns coral and thickens to 2px.

Do give every control an accessible name and state — useId()-paired labels on fields, aria-pressed plus a day-qualified label on each meal tile, aria-label on every sheet, role="status"/role="alert" on toasts, and a real <h1> in the top bar.
donts: Don't add soft drop-shadow floating cards, gradient app bars, or blurred gradient blobs. These are the confirmed anti-references the Ardoise identity was built to remove.
Don't express "not eating" — or any other refusal — as a greyed, unset, or empty checkbox. Absence and refusal must never look alike.
Don't put a form input in a filled box, an outlined rectangle, or a Material-style container. Fields are a chalk underline on transparent, always.
Don't add light mode, a theme toggle, or light-mode tokens. Dark-only is an identity commitment, not a default.

Don't animate anything beyond press feedback, the 0.16s sheet fade/rise, the splash crest's breathe, and the spinner's staggered dot bounce. No entrance staggers, no scroll reveals, no page transitions.
Don't use sage or red for anything other than meal state and system verdict, and don't use lilac anywhere except an avatar fill.
Don't import an icon set, icon font, or emoji. Every glyph is drawn and filtered.
Don't use pure black, pure white, or a neutral grey. The ground is warm slate; the ink is warm chalk.
Don't introduce a sharp 0px corner or a half-round pill on a wide rectangle — soft rectangle or full circle, nothing between.
Don't make the user press Save. Attendance and notes persist optimistically on interaction.
Don't put text, a placeholder, or a meaning-carrying icon on chalk-faint. It measures ~2.1:1 and fails WCAG AA at every size.
